name: floor-S01-adult-bare-b
refs: Our signed S01 key sheet (project-owned): the same creature in every cell; edit only what the prompt names.
prompt: Edit this key sheet. Keep every cell exactly as it is: the same creature, pose, size, place, outline, colours, light and brush, and the same magenta background. Change only two things in every cell where the creature shows them: (1) remove the three leaves on top of the head and paint the bare head there, round and whole, continuing the head's own dark coat, outline and top-left light, with no stub, no scar and no flat cut; (2) make the pale rings around the eyes thin, a narrow pale rim around each eye, the eyes themselves unchanged. On the sleeping cell, the folded leaves are removed the same way. No new parts, no text, no borders, no shadow changes, no glow.
